caption:
Home equity borrowing just hit a milestone. 🏠

The New York Fed says HELOC balances rose $23 billion last quarter to $481 billion, the biggest quarterly jump since 2005.

A HELOC is borrowing against your home, so missed payments carry bigger stakes than a card.

Do you think more people are tapping home equity to cover everyday costs?
